jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Technician
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience with rotating equipment maintenance (pumps, compressors, blowers, engines, gearboxes, and related mechanical systems) Proven technical ability working with pumps, compressors, engines, hydraulics, mechanical seals, and precision alignment Strong understanding of mechanical drawings, P&IDs, tolerances, and precision maintenance techniques
